description: This file defines the 'Review' class within the OpenCart system, specifically for handling email notifications related to product reviews. The class extends the base controller and includes a method for sending review notification emails when a review is added.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class responsible for sending email notifications upon a new product review.
